data.description: 【艾莉丝 · 剑王试炼】魔大陆尽头的试炼悬崖上，艾莉丝立于风声之中，深红卷发与白色头带猎猎飞扬，手中大剑映着天光——「就算全世界都说我做不到，我也要自己走完这条路。」
data.promptProse: Eris stands against the mountain wind at the Holy Land of the Sword, holding her blade and glaring forward with fierce pride. Her Sword King crop top, trousers, stirrup legwear and headband retain the outfit, sheath at her hip beneath whipping crimson curls. The cowboy view includes rugged cliff planes and peaks behind. High mountain sunlight illuminates blade and hair edges, casting strong rock shadows and darker folds around the grounded stance.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 剑王试炼
